description: Computes fixed-rate monthly principal and interest payments, total interest, payoff month and a complete amortization table of at most 360 rows from entered amounts and a nominal annual rate. Optional down payment reduces principal; extra monthly principal payments shorten the modeled term. Uses exact rational arithmetic and nearest-cent half-up rounding. Taxes, insurance, PMI and fees are excluded. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

annualRatePercent.description: Fixed nominal annual interest rate in percent, excluding fees; at most six decimal places.

downPayment.description: USD amount subtracted from principal; must be less than principal; at most two decimal places; defaults to zero.

extraMonthly.description: Extra principal paid each month in USD; at most two decimal places; defaults to zero.

principal.description: Starting amount in USD before the optional down payment; at most two decimal places.

termMonths.description: Original or remaining whole-month term. Every period is returned, at most 360 rows.

name: loan_schedule

outputSchema.description: USD financedPrincipal, regular payment, extraMonthly, totalInterest, totalPaid, payoffMonth, finalPayment, and complete table of month/payment/principal/interest/balance. Monthly interest and regular payment round half up to cents; final payment clears the balance; table sums reconcile exactly in cents.

title: Loan Payment Calculator
